email_body:
Dear founders,

Cashfeed's gap is a clear one: marketing builds attention, Sales closes deals, and the layer in between — turning interest into qualified pipeline — has no owner. That's the layer I want to build.

I'm not a dialer. I'm a hands-on digital marketer who works in analytics, SEO/GEO and CMS tooling every day, and who builds rather than manages: my own site at baverok.com, client sites in WordPress/Elementor, enquiry flows, schema, llms.txt, and the reporting that shows whether any of it works. I use Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs daily to track traffic and results, and I automate the repetitive parts with Python, MCP integrations and LLMs.

I work from Zwijndrecht, Belgium, so the Belgian market is home ground; my Dutch is improving (writing B1, speaking A2+).

I'd welcome a conversation about how you want that engine built.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear founders,

You've described a role with no owner: the layer between attention and revenue. Cashfeed has the product, the 500+ finance teams and the sales team; what's missing is the repeatable system that turns interest into qualified conversations. That's the part I want to own.

What I'd bring is the builder's half of demand generation. I work hands-on with the tools the measurement layer runs on: Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Ads, plus structured data, llms.txt and GEO work for AI search. I design, build and maintain websites myself — my own at baverok.com, a Belgian youth chess champion's site at mirook.com, and client sites in WordPress/Elementor at Episto — including the enquiry flow that captures interest and the schema that makes content discoverable. I automate recurring work with Python, MCP integrations and LLMs rather than doing it by hand.

I'll be straight about the gap: my titles have been SEO and digital marketing, not pipeline operator. I haven't managed an SDR, and I haven't run an ABM motion yet. What I have done is build from zero, set up tracking so every step is visible, iterate on what the numbers said, and kill what didn't move. That is the same discipline this role needs; the motions themselves I can learn fast and build in your stack.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, so the first market you're targeting is home ground, and my Dutch is active and improving (writing B1, speaking A2+). The step to the Netherlands after that is a translation exercise I'd enjoy.

I'd like to hear how you picture the Belgian system in its first 90 days.

Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
- Measurement and reporting toolkit: Google Analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs and Google Ads, used daily at Episto and KXP to track results and report on performance
- Hands-on builder, not a manager: designed and built baverok.com myself (hand-coded landing page, WebGL hero, enquiry/lead-capture flow, structured data) plus client sites in WordPress, Elementor and Shopify
- Data-driven iteration on measurable outcomes: iterative technical SEO/GEO audits on mirook.com that measurably raised its search-health score, and keyword-targeted content built to grow organic traffic
- AI and automation for scale: daily LLM use (Claude, ChatGPT), MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools, Python automation, an Android app live on Google Play, HTML/CSS/JavaScript
- Belgium-based and multilingual: Zwijndrecht, Belgium; English fluent, Dutch writing B1 / speaking A2+ and improving; remote collaboration experience at Episto and a front-end development background (ViviDoctor)
